load_obj_mesh: load an OBJ file and extract vertices, faces, normals, and texture coordinates using load_obj
save_obj_mesh: save vertices and faces to an OBJ file with optional normals and texture maps using save_obj
load_objs_as_meshes_batch: load multiple OBJ files as a batched Meshes object with textures using load_objs_as_meshes
join_meshes_as_batch: join multiple Meshes objects into a single batched Meshes using join_meshes_as_batch
parse_mtl_materials: parse an MTL material file to extract material colors and texture file paths using _parse_mtl
